lesson: Don't buy immediately after a >5% earnings jump; wait for a pull‑back confirmation
Set stops based on recent volatility rather than fixed percentages
Limit position size on symbols that have moved >8% intraday
Don't buy immediately after a large earnings jump; wait for a pull‑back confirmation
Set stops based on recent volatility rather than fixed percentages
Limit position size on symbols that have moved >8% intraday
Avoid buying immediately after a 10%+ jump on earnings day; wait at least 30 minutes for trend confirmation.
For short entries, require price to stay below VWAP and both m15 and m60 to remain negative; exit if either crosses above.
Set stops that account for a stock’s recent volatility (e.g., use ATR‑based stops for high‑rvol stocks like FLY).
